description: This file defines the enum ShareToAgentSettings, which manages shared user default settings related to instructions within the app. It provides methods to load and save a default instruction string, utilizing UserDefaults with a specific suite name.

classes.name: ShareToAgentSettings
classes.description: A public enum providing static methods and constants for managing shared user default settings related to agent instructions.

methods.name: loadDefaultInstruction
methods.description: Retrieves the default instruction string from UserDefaults, returning a fallback message if none is set or if it is empty.

methods.name: saveDefaultInstruction
methods.description: Saves or removes the default instruction string in UserDefaults based on the input, trimming whitespace and handling empty or nil values accordingly.
